notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K of DuPont de Nemours, Inc. (CIK 1666700, accession 0001666700-26-000013, filed February 17, 2026) and its 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-26-151204, ownership as of April 7, 2026). Ellen Kullman is a former CEO of the predecessor E. I. du Pont de Nemours and Company (EIDP). She does not appear anywhere in the 2026 proxy, whose table covers current directors and nominees, current named executive officers and more-than-5% holders, so status is no-reported-stake. COMPANY CHANGES: on November 1, 2025 DuPont completed the spin-off of its electronics business as Qnity Electronics, Inc.; the Electronics, Aramids (sold April 1, 2026) and earlier M&M businesses are reported as discontinued operations, so the FY2025 10-K recasts net sales to $6,849 million (continuing operations) and figures here are not comparable with the FY2024 edition ($12,386 million). DuPont also effected a 1-for-3 reverse stock split on June 24, 2026 (Q3 2026 10-Q); the proxy share counts are before it, and percentages are unaffected. 5% HOLDERS: both rest on Schedule 13G amendments reporting holdings at the end of 2023, so they are stale relative to the April 2026 share count. DIVIDENDS: $597 million paid to stockholders; distributions to noncontrolling interests ($9 million) are a separate line and excluded. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line 'Purchases of common stock and forward contracts' ($500m) is cash paid to repurchase DuPont's own stock (tagged with a company-specific XBRL concept, so no xbrl object); the $8 million excise tax paid on treasury stock purchases is a separate line and not included. STOCK COMP: the continuing-operations cash-flow add-back ($38 million; the FY2025 10-K recast 2024 to $56 million). GEOGRAPHY: continuing operations; China/Hong Kong was $708 million within Asia Pacific. No broad employee stock purchase plan was identified in the 10-K, so plan is null.

R&D: continuing-operations line ($193 million), not comparable with the FY2024 edition's $531 million, which included the electronics business.

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001666700-26-000013). Continuing-operations basis throughout: net sales, operating cash flow, capex and cash interest and taxes are all for continuing operations, after the November 1, 2025 Qnity (electronics) spin-off and with the Aramids business (sold April 1, 2026) in discontinued operations; discontinued operations provided 852 of operating cash and are excluded. Not comparable with the FY2024 edition, which included the electronics business. Interest paid is tagged only with a company-specific concept, so it carries no xbrl object. "Acquisitions of property and businesses, net of cash acquired" (55) is one combined line that includes business acquisitions, so it is excluded. The 4,100 distribution received from Electronics at spin-off is a financing inflow and does not affect the formula.

owners.notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM's separate row for Qnity Electronics Inc (the November 2025 spin-off) is not counted. CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. DuPont's CUSIP changed from 26614N102 to 26614N201 with the 1-for-3 reverse stock split effective June 24, 2026, so the row is found under the new CUSIP; CalPERS's separate Qnity Electronics row is not counted. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count at October 30, 2026 (post-split), the same count used in the marketcap lens.
